model.label: Novel Writer Model
model.help: Gemini text model used for fiction generation.

language.label: Default Language
language.help: Default novel output language, for example zh-CN or en-US.

genre.label: Default Genre
genre.help: Optional default fiction genre profile, for example urban_female, scifi_hard, or ancient_romance.

thinking.label: Default Thinking
thinking.help: Optional default thinking level for long-form writing.

maxTokens.label: Default Max Tokens
maxTokens.help: Optional max output token cap for novel generation.

timeoutMs.label: Timeout Ms
timeoutMs.help: Optional timeout for novel generation requests.

save.label: Save Output
save.help: Save generated novel text into the current agent workspace by default.

fileName.label: Output File Name
fileName.help: Optional output filename for the saved markdown draft.
